summary: Authored complete blameless postmortem for OrderProcessor v2.14 silent order drop incident.
evidence: Summary paragraph covers exact revenue impact ($186k), order count (1400), duration (1h 34m), and mechanism.
Combined chronological timeline and rigorous 5-whys root cause analysis reaching systemic design failures.
Systemic root cause defined around silent exception suppression and decoupling HTTP status from database persistence.
Identified 4 distinct contributing factors including schema divergence, missing domain metrics, and stale rollback scripts.
Action items specify strict roles (no individuals), firm deadlines, and precise Definitions of Done.
Zero individual names used anywhere in the document.
